title: Real Estate Data Scraper
description: This project automates the collection of property-listing data from real-estate websites using web-scraping techniques. It uses Python (likely BeautifulSoup/Requests/Selenium) to crawl listings, extract structured features such as price, location, bedrooms/bathrooms, and stores the results for further analysis. The tool is designed for building datasets of real-estate listings which can be used for market-analysis or investment research.
